lines.t: Hear the earth tremble, the mountains break at dawn
Foundations collapse, who can stand when he is drawn
Fire in his eyes, oceans writhe at his glance
A thunder in the heavens, creation reels and treads
He treads the nations, ten thousand fall like grain
Sword from his mouth divides, the soul carves the slain
The land staggers, valleys run dry at his voice
His burning anger, a river none shall rejoice
His footsteps ignite volcanoes, clouds flee in dread
Blood mixed with tears, let mortals bow their heads
Wickedness reaped destruction Pride cast to the dust
Islands scatter, mountains melt Iron turns to rust
Behold the right hand of God Tremble in fear
Reverence overtakes the crowd As the end draws near
Jealousy burns while consuming fire
Power put on open display
Judgment climbing higher
Blood covers the land
Rivers run red through stone
Cities collapse amidst anguish
Every idol overthrown
The cries of the innocent
Climb unanswered and shrill
The wrath reserved unspent
Now poured and still
Graves ripped wide
Darkness choking the air
Who shall escape when the fearsome judge is there?
Lament erupts from Zion, thunder splits the skies
Woe to the proud, every heart faints, every liar dies
Lightning splits the silence
Smoke billows from his feet
The armies of men brought low their ruin complete
Day of terror and brilliance
Mercy for those who repent
The rest swept away by the storm He has sent
Let every nation tremble
Let all kings fall down
The weight of His glory crushes every crown
Our tears and blood mingle as the final moment comes
He stands unveiled, He alone, the all-consuming One
We'll be right back.
